findings.finding: Real estate offers a potential for passive income, unlike gold.
findings.qualification: This is stated in a comparative sense highlighting real estate as a better option for passive income compared to gold.

findings.finding: Ownership restrictions hinder international real estate investment in certain markets.
findings.qualification: Visa requirements affect the ability to own property properly. The full extent of the impact is not detailed.

findings.finding: Real estate developers cannot access funds from escrow accounts until project completion.
findings.qualification: This implies security for investors but requires confirmation across different markets and developers as policies can vary.

findings.finding: Mortgages can be obtained for properties nearing completion without a title deed.
findings.qualification: This flexibility may not apply universally and may depend on local property laws and financial institution policies.

findings.finding: There has been a significant increase in real estate clients due to good pandemic management.
findings.qualification: The specifics of what constitutes 'good pandemic management' are not detailed, nor how it translates to increased clientele.

findings.finding: Brokers play an important role in connecting clients with engineering firms for property handovers.
findings.qualification: The necessity of such services and their impact on the buying process are not fully explored.

findings.finding: Investment opportunities vary among cosmopolitan cities, drawing international players.
findings.qualification: The capacity of these cities to maintain investor interest under fluctuating global conditions is not assessed.

findings.finding: The real estate market allegedly remains robust despite external conflicts.
findings.qualification: Stability claims are not accompanied by detailed performance metrics or cross-referenced data.
